themes.title: Transnational Right Weaponizes French Riots
themes.blurb: Right-wing political figures in both France and the United States are seizing on recent French civil unrest to push shared law-and-order rhetoric. While Rassemblement National frames the riots as evidence of a collapsing French state, MAGA strategists are actively incorporating the turmoil into US midterm campaign messaging.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen leverages domestic riots and urban violence to argue the French state is collapsing, cementing her hardline platform.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump campaign operatives exploit coverage of French unrest to stoke security fears and energize their base ahead of midterms.

themes.title: Hardline Anti‑Immigration Policies Surge
themes.blurb: Populist right parties across Europe and North America are intensifying their focus on aggressive anti-immigration proposals and border enforcement. In Norway, FrP is calling for third-country asylum processing and restricted family reunification, echoing the Trump administration's ongoing border wall litigation and elevated deportation numbers.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Party leader Sylvi Listhaug advocates closing doors to new immigrants and outsourcing asylum processing to third countries.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The administration highlights rising deportation totals while pursuing Supreme Court approval for border wall expansion and purging noncitizens from voter rolls.

themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple Western democracies are rallying supporters and sustaining polling strength ahead of upcoming legislative and executive elections. High-profile campaign blitzes in the United States parallel strong presidential polling for Marine Le Pen in France and assertive agenda-setting by Norway's FrP.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and Vance execute high-volume campaign rallies and heavy financial investments to defend their congressional majority.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen maintains resilient polling leadership and frontrunner status ahead of the French presidential election.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP drives public debates on key policy issues to challenge the ruling government and build electoral support.
